derivation: For any hypothetical completion in the declared scope, the independent domain/filter premises retain all its local stars. Their one-hot simplex point satisfies exact reciprocity and full-neighborhood moments. For arbitrary q and moment weights with abs(y)<=D, the L1 moment residual is at least (y*b-sum_center max(M^T*y+R^T*q))/D. A strictly positive independently evaluated bound contradicts zero residual in that conditional family only.
scope: Retain 120 baseline K edges including all 7 cross and 6 other same-sign matchings; all same-fibre and unlisted other-coordinate absences fixed. Unknown 480 same-sign edges at root groups 0,1,2,3 plus 1680 disjoint-support edges.
shared_components: prior independent raw-neighborhood scorer and rook controls
pinned complete domain/filter/model/export reviews; these use NumPy/SciPy sparse operations, but this scoring path does not
limitations: A numerical checkpoint is never itself a certificate; only the separately checked integer weights and all column maxima enter this result.
Scope 120 fixed K edges and prescribed other absences; no unrestricted target resolution or nontrivial automorphism assumption.
Nonpositive attempts prove neither feasibility nor exclusion; no claim of optimality.
Resumed completed attempt receipts, if used, are bound to this checker source and all frozen inputs; they are repeated evidence, not another independent implementation.
